import json,sys,subprocess,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'nuvem')
from benchmark import solver_bridge as b
from benchmark.extract.from_solver import project_from_solver
from benchmark.runner import evaluate_project
p=Path('docs/checkpoints/evidence/main-safe-region-final.json'); source=json.loads(p.read_text())
data=source['input_selection']; native_heights=[w['height_cm'] for w in data['walls']]
for wall in data['walls']:
 wall['height_cm']=340.0;wall['junctions']=[]
data['settings']['walls_already_extended']=False
data['metadata']={'scope':'ENGINEERING_BENCH_ONLY; two reference walls of uniform 340cm height, NOT substitution of native TP1 walls with 260/280cm heights','source_project':'torre_easy_lo_r00_tp1','source_indices':[75,81],'native_wall_heights_cm':native_heights,'source_artifact_sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
with Path('docs/checkpoints/evidence/main-safe-engineering-input.json').open('x') as f:json.dump(data,f,indent=2)
m=b.engine();nodes,walls,ends,openings=b.plan_from_input(data);catalog,cells,dropped=b.catalog_from_input(data)
h=m._PostCreationEventHandler();h.controlled_beta=True;h.wall_graph_nodes=nodes;h.wall_end_to_node=ends;h.walls_to_create=walls;h.openings_per_wall=openings;h.catalog=catalog;h.base_z_abs=b._ft(612);h.wall_height_ft=b._ft(340);h.selected_level=object();h._execute_solve();h._require_current_beta_solve()
r=h.solve_result;k=r['num_courses'];assert k==17;assert r['beta_preflight']['ok']
project=project_from_solver('tp1_engineering_bench_75_81',r,walls,nodes,openings,catalog,h.base_z_abs,k,metadata={'cells_reconstructed':cells,'catalog_codes_dropped':dropped})
ref=json.loads(Path('nuvem/benchmark/projects/torre_easy_lo_r00_tp1/reference.json').read_text());f,s,c=evaluate_project(project,ref)
assert not f and not s['validator_errors'];assert all(a['ok'] for a in r['wall_bond_audits'].values());assert not r['unmodulated_walls']
assert project['walls']==source['result_project']['walls'];assert project['catalog']==source['result_project']['catalog']
payload={'head':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),'scope':data['metadata'],'handler_execute_solve':True,'signature_verified':True,'exact_walls_and_catalog_equal_final_probe':True,'courses':k,'physical_blocks':sum(map(len,r['course_candidates'].values())),'preflight':r['beta_preflight'],'bond_audits':r['wall_bond_audits'],'result_project':project,'score':s,'findings':f}
with Path('docs/checkpoints/evidence/main-safe-handler-bench.json').open('x') as o:json.dump(payload,o,separators=(',',':'))
print(json.dumps({x:payload[x] for x in ('head','handler_execute_solve','signature_verified','exact_walls_and_catalog_equal_final_probe','courses','physical_blocks','preflight')},indent=2))
